prompts.name: leemusk_cover_up1
prompts.prompt: Upscale and restore image 1 into a sharp, high-resolution press photo. Keep EVERYTHING exactly the same: the same two men, identical faces, expressions, glasses, hair, clothes, pose, the 'Welcome Tes' sign text, background, framing and lighting. Only remove blur, JPEG artifacts and noise and add natural fine detail. Do not beautify, do not change faces or age, do not add or remove anything, no new text, no logo, no watermark.
